vercel.assessment: Vercel now shows the intended diagnostic split: percepcion and vitalidad are ready, diferenciacion abstains, and empty-text evidence is blocked from normal eligibility.
interpretation: The packet is not globally over-conservative because high-evidence dimensions still pass.
The packet is still not prompt-ready because diferenciacion exposes an acquisition/input gap rather than a prose problem.
URL-only evidence is now visible as blocked or missing instead of silently entering eligible evidence.

builtwith_kit_com.assessment: Builtwith/Kit remains blocked across dimensions because the packet sees unresolved entity and surface ambiguity before narrative use.
interpretation: The classifier prevents builtwith.kit.com, kit.com, and builtwith.com evidence from being smoothed into one entity story.
This is the desired failure mode for a noisy entity-mixed case.

watermelon.assessment: Watermelon remains mixed: coherencia is marked ready by local owned-surface evidence, but presencia and percepcion are thin while diferenciacion/vitalidad are blocked by review/entity ambiguity.
interpretation: The result is still review-heavy and confirms that local snapshots are weaker than Deep Research for related-surface verification.
The ready coherencia status should be treated as a narrow intra-entity messaging readiness, not proof that the whole ecosystem is verified.

launchdarkly.assessment: LaunchDarkly stays usable but not fully ready: vitalidad is ready, presencia/percepcion are thin, coherencia requires review, and diferenciacion abstains without comparative evidence.
interpretation: This keeps useful evidence available without letting comparison-dependent prose proceed unsupported.
The case is stable enough for later prompt-input candidate tests, but diferenciacion still needs competitor/category evidence.

why: The packet can now tell generation which dimensions are ready, thin, blocked, abstain, or review-gated.
It exposes acquisition gaps before narrative generation rather than asking the LLM to rationalize them.
It still lacks upstream collection contracts for competitor corpus, official profile verification, and richer source-role metadata.

remaining_acquisition_changes: Verify official social/profile links from owned surfaces before using them as channel evidence.
Separate repository activity from adoption evidence.
Capture non-empty text for URL evidence before it can support readiness.
Improve local related-surface verification so Watermelon-like cases do not rely on manual review as heavily.
